title: Scraper Wizard Start Permission Consistency

items.action: start a scraper automation through the Operation wizard

database.reason: No persistence model changes are introduced.

migration.reason: The existing fair_crm.scraper.execute permission is reused.

audit.reason: Existing operation create/start audit behavior is unchanged.

menu.reason: No navigation menu changes are introduced.

route_guard.reason: Route-level operation wizard cleanup is intentionally handled separately.

notes: Scraper Wizard Start is one user-triggered business action. For start_immediately scraper requests, Operation creation and Operation start are orchestration only and must not add fair_crm.operations.create or fair_crm.operations.execute prerequisites. Retry and route guards remain out of scope.
